_about: Benjamin Jowett (1817-1893), Regius Professor of Greek and Master of Balliol College, Oxford: his own writings, as distinct from his translations (Plato, Thucydides, Aristotle's Politics), which are on those authors' shelves. Raw IA OCR: The Epistles of St. Paul to the Thessalonians, Galatians, Romans, with critical notes and dissertations, second edition (London: John Murray, 1859), 2 vols; the three posthumous sermon volumes edited by W. H. Fremantle, Dean of Ripon (died 1916): College Sermons (1895), Sermons Biographical and Miscellaneous (1899) and Sermons on Faith and Doctrine (1901); and The Interpretation of Scripture and Other Essays (London Library; London: George Routledge; New York: E. P. Dutton; no year printed in the OCR), which reprints his Essays and Reviews essay from the fifth edition (1861) and the dissertations from the 1859 Epistles, with Leslie Stephen's 1897 essay on his life (Stephen died 1904). Also held, on the lewis-campbell shelf: the Jowett-Campbell Republic (1894, 3 vols), the Life and Letters by Abbott and Campbell (1897, 2 vols), the Letters (1899) and Campbell's Select Passages from his theological writings (1902). Not taken: Essays and Reviews (1860) itself, a seven-author volume; a 2020 Quadriga reprint of the Interpretation essay; Statements of Christian Doctrine and Practice (1861), extracts made by another hand; De Etruscorum Cultu (1841), Latin. Added at Adam's request, 2026-10-23 (lane B, round dy). No uids minted.
